title: BLACK TORCH Prepares For Final Episodes With New Trailer
content: BLACK TORCH released a new “FINAL PV” trailer ahead of its concluding episodes, featuring footage from Episodes 11 and 12. The series first announced the anime adaptation back in March, surprising with its return following the manga’s cancellation in 2018. The anime is streaming on Crunchyroll.
author: Anime Corner

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2 Anime Reveals September 26 Early Streaming Debut, More Cast in 2nd Promo Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Firehead and YahaKo 's A Wild Last Boss Appeared! light novel series revealed a second promotional video, more cast, September 26 early streaming debut, and ending theme song artist on Friday for the show's second season.
author: ANN

title: A Certain Item of Dark Side Anime Reveals Key Visual
content: The upcoming A Certain ITEM of Dark Side anime has revealed a new key visual featuring the main characters ahead of the show’s October 9, 2026. The anime previously revealed all its members with a trailer .
author: Anime Corner

title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Reveals Collaboration Visual With From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman, Episode 1 Preview
content: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 has revealed a new collaboration visual with From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2, as well as the synopsis and preview for its first episode.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Psyren' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, Main Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga revealed additional cast, staff, opening theme, key visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 11.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11 and Sun TV.
author: MyAnimeList

title: PSYREN Anime Reveals New Visual, Trailer, Theme Song, Voice Cast
content: The upcoming PSYREN anime revealed a new trailer, key visual, and cast ahead of the show’s October 5, 2026 premiere. It was also previously confirmed that it will be a complete adaptation , covering the entirety of the story.
author: Anime Corner

title: Psyren TV Anime Reveals More Cast, Opening Theme Artist, October 5 Debut in Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga revealed on Friday the show's October 5 debut in a new video. The staff also revealed more cast, the opening theme song artist, and a new key visual.
author: ANN

title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 Reveals Main Trailer and Visual, October 7 Premiere With 1-Hour Special
content: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 will premiere on October 7, 2026, with a one-hour special episode, revealing a new main trailer and visual ahead of the broadcast. Tasuku Hatanaka and Yu Sasahara are also joining the cast, while MADKID will perform the opening theme “Unbroken.” Season 2 will feature some notable staff…
author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Ao to Midori BL Series Unveils Theme Song Artists, Visual
content: The official website for the live-action series of Roji 's Ao to Midori (Ao and Midori) boys' love manga presented a new visual and the opening theme song artist for the series on Thursday.
author: ANN
